sentences.text: Machine learning finds patterns in training data.
A model that memorizes its training data will always do well on new data.
sentences.explanation: Memorizing is not generalizing. New data is the real test.

sentences.text: Labels are the right answers attached to training examples.
A model's prediction is always a proven fact.
sentences.explanation: A prediction is an informed guess and it can be wrong.

sentences.text: Traditional software follows rules that a person wrote.
Testing data is the same data the model trained on.
sentences.explanation: Testing uses data the model has NOT seen.

copy.trueMiss: That one is actually true. Look for something that sounds too sure.
